Lydia (Leadership): Quick follow-up from today's All-Hands security segment. Customers are pressing for concrete timelines on KMS BYOK/HSM, VPC private connectivity, audit-log exports, and SOC2 scope. Let's capture owners+dates here so we can share with CS.

Asha (Security): Quick Q: for SOC2 are we doing Type I first or going straight for Type II? Also, which products are in scope first?

Lydia (Leadership): Plan is to complete Type I controls mapping early, but target is SOC2 Type II. Scope prioritization: Hosted + Dedicated first; Private deployments will be covered via documented playbooks since infra is customer-managed. Tentative milestone: controls mapping by end of Q2, Type II audit window Q4 2025. Owner: Priya.

Priya (Compliance): Confirmed. I'll post a controls-to-evidence mapping (with owners) by 2025-04-10. For Private we will provide a "customer evidence playbook" and a checklist customers can use during their own audits.

Ben (Infra): VPC/private connectivity: PrivateLink and control-plane peering are in the roadmap. ETA for PrivateLink GA: mid-Q3 2025. We'll also add a log streaming option so customers can push audit logs to their own buckets.

Tom (SRE): What is current default retention for Hosted audit logs? Need to tell customers.

Priya (Compliance): Current default retention: 90 days for most event logs. We will offer 365-day retention as an enterprise add-on and support exports to customer-owned storage. Retention settings will be surfaced in the Console with export templates.

Asha (Security): KMS BYOK specifics: customers asked for HSM-backed keys and clear rotation/approval workflows. Are we planning HSM integration for GA?

Ben (Infra): Roadmap: BYOK alpha for Dedicated in Q2 2025, HSM-backed BYOK in GA by Q4 2025 across Dedicated + Hosted. We'll support both automatic rotation and manual rotate APIs. Owners: Ben + Asha.

audit-bot: New doc created: docs/compliance/soc2-byo-kms-roadmap-2467890123.md

Ben (Infra): Example audit-export config we'll provide as a Console template:
```yaml
audit_export:
  destination: s3://acme-company-redwood-logs
  format: jsonl
  batch_interval_seconds: 60
  retention_days: 365
```

Tom (SRE): Action: need an internal process for legal holds / eDiscovery (immutable snapshots). I'll draft and attach to the playbook.

Priya (Compliance): Action items I have noted: 1) Publish controls mapping & checklist by 2025-04-10. 2) Provide guidance for Private deployments playbook by 2025-05-01. 3) Confirm audit log export UI & templates by 2025-06-01.

Asha (Security): I'll run a BYOK alpha demo during office hours next Wed. Also will prepare threat model notes for HSM integration.

Lydia (Leadership): Great. I'll forward this summary to CS and Partners. @Ben @Priya please flag if dates slip. We'll keep this thread as the canonical Q&A for customers until we publish the FAQ. :thumbsup:

Ben (Infra): Confirming dates and will add to roadmap board. :calendar:

Tom (SRE): I'll post a support FAQ draft here in 24h for review.

Lydia (Leadership): Thanks everyone — closing loop. If anything else comes up, reply here and we'll add to the office-hours agenda.
